description:
"'??'s favorability rating has increased."

The game I was trying to play wouldn't work, so I slammed my laptop in frustration, driven by drunken rage and a sense of hopelessness. Surprisingly, I found myself in a dating simulation game!

But why does my favorability rating keep increasing, even when I make bad choices?

This game is fucking ruined.

[RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/211030490), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/sybk1608), [Bookcube](https://www.bookcube.com/detail.asp?series_num=919021584)
